title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.2 is a public research preview of a strict structural checker for typed scientific claims. Gate conflicts, omitted bound failures, failed proof transitions, missing arithmetic configuration, execution-ledger short circuits, and schema/runtime drift are preserved as regression tests. A clear run means only that no implemented blocking condition fired on the declared input. This metadata applies to the Apache-2.0 software release assets; the separately archived Audit Descent Calculus paper is CC BY 4.0 and has its own metadata record.
